title: Stack
text: Store inputs into LIFO register, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Pop empty stack} sets Pop empty stack; {Stack depth} sets the number of entries stack can hold, {Trigger type}, {Push full stack}, {Show empty stack indicator port (Empty)} enables empty stack indicator port, {Show full stack indicator port (Full)} enables full stack indicator port, {Show number of stack entries port (Num)} enables number of stack entries port, {Show reset port (Rst) to clear internal stack buffer} enables reset port and {Clear output port on reset}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Push
ports.summary: Trigger event to push input scalar

ports.name: Pop
ports.summary: Trigger event to pop elements scalar

ports.name: Num
ports.summary: Number of stack entries port scalar

params.name: Stack depth
params.values: Number of entries stack can hold 8 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Trigger type Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Push full stack
params.values: Push full stack Dynamic reallocation (default) | Ignore | Warning | Error

params.name: Pop empty stack
params.values: Pop empty stack Warning (default) | Ignore | Error

params.name: Show empty stack indicator port (Empty)
params.values: Enable empty stack indicator port off (default) | on

params.name: Show full stack indicator port (Full)
params.values: Enable full stack indicator port off (default) | on

params.name: Show number of stack entries port (Num)
params.values: Enable number of stack entries port off (default) | on
